author: root

checks.description: Host tests demonstrate discovery under the exact eMMC controller for a target with a non-assumed Linux mmcN number, ignore an unrelated small SD, and reject multiple matching MMC cards.
Beelink succeeds with default NFSv3/TCP mountd port discovery without explicit mountport and confirms export write refusal.
Warnings-as-errors init build, refreshed exact-hash NFS manifest/composition evidence, and separate high-consequence review before another physical boot.
Record the first supervised attempt as NFS failure before probe execution, preserve private trace hash, and leave current eMMC boot counters unknown.

constraints.text: Search only beneath the exact 4022000.mmc controller, retain unique nominal-32GB MMC selection and read-only fixed-offset access, and fail closed on ambiguity. Passing fixture tests does not establish physical eMMC initialization.

Verify default NFSv3/TCP mountd discovery, read-only refusal, and the expected printer-address export. Record how mountd registration is maintained for the proposed retry; persistent Beelink configuration changes require separate scope review.

Record the first boot as an NFS failure before probe execution, with current counters unknown. Before another physical boot, obtain a separate GPT-6 Sol high-consequence review of exact deployed hashes, NFS state, MMC initialization evidence, and single-boot stop conditions.

decision.rationale: The correction addresses the measured NFS refusal and the probe's unstable mmc2 assumption within the approved disposable diagnostic. The physical trace contains no probe result and shows a non-removable MMC initialization failure, so eMMC visibility and current counters remain unknown. The existing approved proposal excludes persistent Beelink configuration changes and hardware writes.
